references.text: Ahira son of Enan is first mentioned as the leader of the tribe of Naphtali in the census.
Ahira son of Enan is listed as the prince over the tribe of Naphtali in the camp arrangement.
Ahira son of Enan led the army of Naphtali during the wilderness journey.
Naphtali was a son of Jacob and Bilhah, and the ancestor of the tribe of Naphtali.
Jacob's blessing over Naphtali, the ancestor of the tribe that Ahira represents.
